in_hebrew.name: בולן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: One whose land is saturated with blood, possibly due to war or sacrifice.

in_greek.name: Βολλων
in_greek.long_meaning: A man whose name means 'rolling' or 'rolling in blood', possibly derived from the Greek word 'ballein' meaning 'to roll'.

in_latin.name: Bollus
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latinized version of the Greek name 'Bollon' or 'Bollos', meaning 'rolling' or 'rolling in blood'.
